summary: Rubico Inc., a Greek-listed foreign private issuer (US-equivalent Form 8-K current report), disclosed that on September 30, 2026 it amended a related-party transaction with TOP Ships Inc. concerning its acquisition of Roman Shark V Inc. from TOPS under a July 27, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement. Aggregate purchase price was $6.5 million, of which $2.8 million is settled in cash; the $3.7 million balance, originally due September 30, 2026, was extended to October 31, 2026 and is payable in cash or, at Rubico's election, newly issued Series G Convertible Preferred Shares. Roman Shark V holds a February 3, 2026 shipbuilding contract with Guangzhou Shipyard International and China Shipbuilding Trading for one 47,499 dwt MR chemical/product tanker. Watch related-party pricing, potential preferred-share dilution, and whether the balance is settled in cash or stock by the October 31 deadline.
